mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and supply chain health, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO shows a sustained upward trend (3-month rolling increase > 0.5%).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO) and decreases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a synchronized economic expansion where supply capacity and labor market strength jointly drive corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term (INDPRO * UNRATE) has a negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annually), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals active monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the average return in these periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS shows a sustained upward trend (3-month rolling increase > 1.0%).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650,000 units, it signals a robust housing market that stimulates construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 650.0.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a policy response to economic weakness that stimulates demand and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.5% and FEDFUNDS declines, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 96.0 (a threshold indicating strong manufacturing momentum) signals accelerating economic activity that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 96.0.
